facts.text: A diverse manufacturing sector is the centre of Chambly's economy, with metal fabricators alongside growing pharmaceutical and electronic output.
facts.evidence: Today a diverse manufacturing sector is the centre of Chambly's economy. Its longstanding shoe, clothing and food processing industries are now rivalled by a large range of metal fabricators and growing pharmaceutical and electronic outputs.

facts.text: The Chambly Canal attracts more than 250,000 visitors and cyclists each year, making it an important recreational tourism destination.
facts.evidence: Le canal de Chambly attire annuellement plus de 250 000 visiteurs et cyclistes, faisant du canal une importante destination récréotouristique.

facts.text: The Chambly Canal stretches nearly 20 kilometres along the Richelieu River between Chambly and Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu.
facts.evidence: Along the Richelieu River, the Chambly Canal stretches nearly 20 kilometres between the municipalities of Chambly and Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu

facts.text: Fort Chambly, built in 1711, stands at the foot of the Richelieu River rapids roughly 30 kilometres southeast of Montreal.
facts.evidence: Roughly 30 kilometres southeast of Montreal, Fort Chambly rises proudly at the foot of the Richelieu River rapids and was built in 1711 to defend the colony

meta.descriptor: a growing South Shore city on the Richelieu River southeast of Montreal
meta.fact: home to Fort Chambly and the Chambly Canal, which draws more than 250,000 visitors and cyclists a year

overview: Chambly counted 31,444 residents in the 2021 Census, up 8.0 percent from 29,120 in 2016. Those residents live in 12,405 occupied dwellings packed into just 25.08 square kilometres, so customers are close together and easy to reach.

Manufacturers, the Chambly Canal and Fort Chambly give the city both a working economy and steady visitor traffic. For a local business, that means competing with Montreal-area chains for growing suburban households while also catching visitors who arrive along the Richelieu.

byService.lead-generation: With 8.0 percent growth since 2016, Chambly keeps adding households, so lead generation should reach new homeowners early with offers tied to moving in and settling into the neighbourhood.
byService.seo: Chambly SEO has to hold its own against Longueuil and Montreal competitors, so pages should target French searches that name Chambly, Vieux-Chambly and the Bassin rather than the whole South Shore.
byService.website-development: Canal cyclists and Fort Chambly visitors look up places on their phones, so a Chambly website needs fast mobile pages, clear hours, maps and simple bilingual content.
byService.branding: In a compact city of about 31,000 people with deep historic roots, Chambly branding that nods to the river and heritage setting helps a business stand apart from regional chains.
